Name: Animated Fish
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Animated Fish
[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]Adds animations for all the fish of Stardew Valley. Check out the config file to disable/enable animations if you don't like some of them (more information below).
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ayleaoy.gif[/img][/center][/size][size=2]
[/size]
[size=5]
[b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/size]
[size=5][u][b][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Mv1iJRc.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/iJ6rKe5.gif[/img][/center]Config[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i]config.json[/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.[/size]
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i]content.json[/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.[/size]

[size=3]Some items have different versions, for example: "Blobfish1", "Blobfish2" and "Blobfish3". [u][b]You [/b][/u][/size][size=4][b][u]can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/u]. 

[/b][/size][size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Link to my other animated fish mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5845]Animated More New Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6089]Animated Fish SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7353]Animated Ridgeside Village Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10913]Animated East Scarp Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11949]Animated Cowboy Life Expanded Fish[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6974]Animated Lunna - Astay Fish[/url].
[/size]
